volume.title: Executive Orders Relating to the Isthmian Canal Commission, March, 1904, to June 12, 1911, inclusive
volume.publisher: Isthmian Canal Commission (catalogued under Canal Zone); printed by the Government Printing Office
volume.digitized_by: University of Florida copy (gift of the Panama Canal Museum); HathiTrust handle 2027/ufl1.ark:/13960/t3dz15k02
volume.supplied: PDF generated by HathiTrust for the owner (New York University login) on 2026-10-18 01:28 GMT and saved to the owner's Downloads on 2026-10-17 (local time) as ufl1-ark--13960-t3dz15k02-1792287042.pdf; added unchanged
volume.extractor: pypdf 6.20.1 extract_text(), one JSON line per PDF page, NUL characters removed; the layer is the scan's own OCR

crosswalk_built_from.lord_unnumbered_entries: the project's parse of Lord's 1943 list of 1,562 unnumbered orders 1789-1941 (UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv, built 2026-10-17, not in the repo)
